 Follow Caitlin Clark Goes 12-for-16 While Shooting Cheeseballs Into Jimmy Fallon's Mouth in 24 Seconds
 Angelo Guinhawa Sat, November 7, 2026 at 1:56 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Indiana Fever star Caitlin Clark turned heads once again for her shooting. This time, however, it's not related to basketball.
 Clark is currently on a press tour as she continues to promote her children's book titled "EXTRAordinary! A Little EXTRA to Reach BIG Dreams." She recently made an appearance on "Good Morning America" and the "Today Show."
 On Friday, the Fever guard also made an appearance on "The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon," during which she discussed her book and gifted Fallon a pair of her Caitlin 1 sneakers.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement What stood out from the interview, however, was the cheeseball challenge that Clark and Fallon took part in during the segment. The Fever star shot the cheeseballs toward Fallon's mouth as the two tested how many she could make in 24 seconds.
 Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark (22) reacts to a call from the referee.USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect via Reuters Connect
 Clark, who was wearing a black dress, made 12 of her 16 cheeseball shots. The Fever sharpshooter was naturally hyped after the challenge, raising her hand and celebrating her performance.
 Fans absolutely loved the moment, with many also sharing how impressed they were by Clark's accuracy.
 "ncaa leading scorer and the best cheeseball shooter," a commenter wrote . Another one said , "She means it when she say from logo to everywhere."
 Advertisement Advertisement A fan added , "[Expletive] catlin!!!!! Especially when wearing heels????"
 "The pure excitement from her. I love my cc down," a supporter shared .
 "That's impressive!" another poster exclaimed .
 A fifth follower shared , "that accuracy is actually scary, she really aimed for the face."
 "The queen never disappoints!!!!" an excited social media user stated .
